correctness.rationale: For fixed n≥4 and positive normalized periodic f∈C³ with r=(1+h)/n, 0<h<1/(n−1), the circle-homotopy event is exactly the all-clockwise-gaps≤r condition: then consecutive sample edges form C_n with no nonconsecutive chords, and a larger gap unwraps to a unit-interval clique complex. Conditional ordered-gap density and substitutions u_i=r−g_i=hV_i yield the exact h^{n−1} Dirichlet simplex expectation. Every centered shift b_j=j/n−∑_{i≤j}V_i has mean 0 and covariance min(j,k)(n−max(j,k))/(n²(n+1)), hence the linear term vanishes and the quadratic Hessian term has O_{n,f}(h³) remainder. Uniform density convergence proves conditional total-variation limit. Arithmetic–geometric mean for n∤k, Jensen for n|k, and the Chebyshev product identity for coprime k yield resonance. Independently checked 4,000 random gap/edge configurations for each n=4..10, all covariance entries and trigonometric quadrature for ε=.4 and k=1..n+1, including Chebyshev values. Finite checks corroborate, while the proof is fixed-n analytical.
